heading_path: 22.12  Amendments made by the Intellectual Property Legislation Amendment (Fee Review) Regulation 2016
text: Despite the repeal of item 9 of Schedule 9 by Part 4 of Schedule 1 to the Intellectual Property Legislation Amendment (Fee Review) Regulation 2016 (the amending Regulation), that item continues to apply in relation to the registration of a trade mark of a kind mentioned in that item if the application for registration was filed before the commencement of the amending Regulation.
